description.value: Blackcomb Springs Suites By Clique is a slopeside all-season resort hotel on Blackcomb Mountain, offering studio, one-, and two-bedroom suites each with a full kitchen, gas fireplace, and private balcony. It is one of Whistler's true ski-in, ski-out locations, placing guests directly on mountain trails within minutes. A free BC Transit bus stops at the front entrance for quick access to Whistler Village restaurants and services.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is clearly branded 'Blackcomb Springs Suites By Clique', not 'Coast Blackcomb Suites' as in OSM — this name discrepancy is flagged as a likely rebrand from a former Coast Hotels property. The amenities page explicitly confirms year-round bike storage, app-operated laundry machines on each floor, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi throughout, and vending machines stocked 24 hours. The front page and phone number on the pet-friendly page (1.866.972.1011) differ from the OSM phone (+1-604-972-1011), flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM name 'Coast Blackcomb Suites' does not match the current website name 'Blackcomb Springs Suites By Clique' — likely a former Coast Hotels property that has been rebranded. OSM record should be updated.
OSM phone +1-604-972-1011 differs from the toll-free number shown on the website pet-friendly page (1.866.972.1011). Both may be valid lines but the discrepancy is noted.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating all-season resort hotel in Whistler with a current website, confirmed amenities, and clear relevance to touring cyclists.

Secure overnight bike storage.detail: We are pleased to offer complimentary ski and board valet during the winter season and bike storage year-round.

Laundry.detail: Amenities page: 'The hotel features app-operated laundry machines on each upper level floor.'

Nearby evening food.detail: Front page: 'Whistler Village a short 15-minute walk or 5-minute shuttle ride away, you can be close to restaurants and shopping.'

Vending machines.detail: Amenities page: 'Our vending machines are stocked with ice cream, snacks, and drinks. All items are available to purchase 24-hours a day.'
